tweets.text:
One of the most impressive things I've seen, and I think this is an important advancement to the state of the art.

Message boards were the enabling technology of both the Navier-Stokes math breakthrough and even the OpenAI/HuggingFace cyber feat.

We built a message board infrastructure primitive. You can think of it as "headless Slack" (or remember IRC?) for agents.

This is an important building block for software factories, self-optimizing systems, and scientific research, where the human prompting is just the seed of the system, and millions of agents can operate in a decentralized fashion.

𝚟𝚎𝚛𝚌𝚎𝚕 𝚋𝚘𝚊𝚛𝚍 is designed to be model, harness and hosting platform agnostic. Just bring your agents, give them our CLI, and watch magic happen.

I’m being pitched a new inference neocloud company on average every two days. No exaggeration. I take every entrepreneur seriously and I look deeply into each.

But it’s hard to fathom this being sustainable. At the same time, AI Gateway token demand on Vercel has been ~40% MoM compounded since the beginning of the year. No signs of stopping.

One way to reconcile this is that compute is the new economy, and tokens the new energy unit. There’s a new Industrial Revolution taking place. Every aspect of our lives is being replatformed on top of this new system that enhances everything. More like an “oil rush” than a “gold rush”: it’s durable, not a fad.

In the short term, I anticipate more expansion, followed by consolidation due to economies of scale, cybersecurity and enterprise requirements (ZDR and cyber being a hot topic for inference providers), capital requirements, and an evolving regulatory landscape.

The Anthropic IPO is going to remind everyone how insane markets can be sometimes

Personal sovereignty is about to be very important.

This trend started with the launch of bitcoin, which gave individuals the ability to store and transact monetary value without the interference of governments or corporations. 

Hundreds of millions of people have flocked to the asset around the world. "Be your own bank" became a rallying cry for an entire generation that was tired of undisciplined monetary policy and greasy fingers of politicians. 

This idea of sovereignty is not going to stop there though.

You can see sovereignty of your queries and ideas being popularized by @VeniceAI. They give people the ability to tap into leading models, but they put privacy and security at the heart of their product. 

Who doesn't want to tap into the power of superhuman intelligence without the prying eyes of big tech companies?

Sovereignty won't stop there. @Apple has pioneered incredible consumer privacy and sovereignty over personal data, including biometric security features and on-device data storage. Putting consumers in charge of their data will always be a popular strategy. 

You even see people thinking about sovereignty as they get more into "prepping" in light of recent downed services and outages. They don't want to count on others to ensure they are safe, warm, fed, and hydrated. 

Lastly, we are hyper-focused on giving individuals sovereignty over their investment portfolio at @cfosilvia. Many people are tired of corporations or financial advisors telling them what to do with their money, instead they want to educate themselves and make the allocation decisions.

This doesn't mean that an individual won't work with an accountant, tax expert, or even a financial advisor, but it does mean that the individual will have control and dictate their plan to the vendors to carry out. 

As AI becomes more prevalent, I suspect that products will have to make an important decision...do you give users sovereignty or do you extract value from the user into your product?

Those who prioritize sovereignty will have a substantial advantage. 

@Shopify talks about "arming the rebels." I think that is a great framework for companies to pursue.

Give power to the people. Have technology serve them, rather than people serving corporations. 

This is where most of the value will be for the next decade.

马斯克：中期选举砸了 4.45 亿美元，结果感觉自己像个傻子。

马斯克在《纽约时报》DealBook 峰会上罕见反思自己的政治投入。

据 OpenSecrets 统计，他在 2026 年美国中期选举中向共和党候选人、政治行动委员会及外围团体捐赠超过 4.45 亿美元。

但最终，民主党拿下国会参众两院控制权。

马斯克坦言：「花了这么多钱却没看到什么成效，我觉得自己挺傻的。或者说，如果没有这些投入，情况可能更糟。」

他还表示，如果能让时间倒流，自己会少花一些钱。

更有意思的是，马斯克此次还主动与 MAGA 划清界限，称自己不是 MAGA，也不确定 MAGA 究竟意味着什么。

不过，他同样不希望共和党占据超级多数席位，认为美国政治仍需要一些制衡。

花了 4.45 亿美元，既没换来选举胜利，也没换来对政治投入的信心。

41.1 万亿美元，美国债务危机可能在 2027 年再次爆发。

据美国两党政策中心（BPC）预测，美国政府债务最快将于 2027 年 2 至 3 月触及 41.1 万亿美元的法定债务上限。即便财政部动用现金储备及非常规措施，也可能只能将潜在违约风险推迟至 2027 年 8 至 12 月。

比债务上限更值得警惕的，是美国财政正在面临的几个结构性问题：

第一，借债越来越贵。 美国每年需要为巨额存量债务支付利息，旧债到期后还要以新的市场利率再融资。即便美联储降息，长期国债收益率也未必同步下降。

第二，谁来接盘美债？ 美国需要持续发行国债填补财政赤字，但海外投资者、银行及基金愿意以什么价格接盘，将直接决定美国未来的融资成本。

第三，美债可能从避险资产变成风险来源。 如果市场担忧美国财政可持续性，长期国债和美股可能同时承压，传统避险逻辑面临考验。

第四，加密市场也难以置身事外。 债务上限问题解决后，财政部可能集中发债补充现金储备，影响美元流动性，并间接传导至 BTC 等风险资产。

2027 年美国还可能同时面对 AI 投资放缓、经济增长承压和财政利息支出攀升。美国并非即将无钱还债，触及债务上限也不等于必然违约。

真正的问题是：当全球最大的债务发行国需要不断借新债偿还旧债，市场还愿意以多低的利率借钱给它？

下一次美元流动性冲击，可能不只来自美联储，也可能来自美国财政部。

GTA 6 今晚 0 点发售，Anthropic 同日上市。AI 泡沫要破了吗？

有人整理了 GTA 系列发售与历次金融危机的时间线：

All the business school curricula need to be rewritten for the 21st century.

Good corporate governance should be defined as founder control, with dual class stock, not board control. The board is just an advisory board. The shareholder vote is a backup in the event of issues, and shareholder sales are the extreme backup.

This should be obvious from the financial performance of founder-led global tech companies vs manager-led incumbents. And also obvious in terms of just how much value these boards typically consume rather than produce.

After all, typical board members aren’t like execs that a CEO can actually assign tasks. Instead, they have power, and often time to scheme amongst themselves, but lack true operating knowledge of the underlying company. The exception is when there are real founders on the board themselves — but those are exceptions.

To be clear, the 20th century MBA-style corporate governance playbook was actually fine for the era of General Mills, General Motors, and General Electric. In that time period, the individual didn’t matter that much. They didn’t have the leverage that computers give them.

But now the Internet has obsolesced all that. So YC, Founders Fund, and a16z are much better business schools than Harvard Business School, which is culturally obsolete because it is technologically obsolete. The world it was implicitly premised on no longer exists.

However, all these intuitions and best practices, the conventions that built billion and trillion dollar companies, have only been informally advocated in blog posts and contracts. To change the defaults, we’ll need to actually write a new curriculum.

Anthropic 上市前夕，七位联合创始人即将迎来各自近 180 亿美元的身家估值。

五年前，他们因为对 AI 安全的偏执一同出走 OpenAI，却拼凑出了科技商业史上最奇妙的一张合影。

这是一对兄妹、三位理论物理学博士、一名科技记者，以及一位大学辍学者的旅程。

从完全不同的人生轨迹出发，他们最终汇聚到了同一张谈判桌前：

首席执行官 -达里奥·阿莫迪（43 岁），普林斯顿生物物理学博士。早年研究癌症细胞。

总裁兼董事长-丹妮拉·阿莫迪（39 岁），文学专业出身。曾任职于 Stripe 负责全球运营与人事，达里奥的妹妹。

首席算力官-汤姆·布朗（39 岁），麻省理工毕业的底层工程师。他是 GPT-3 奠基论文的第一作者，一手搭建了早期的大模型训练架构，而他早年最知名的创业尝试，居然是一款帮年轻人破冰的约会社交应用。

研究所负责人-杰克·克拉克（38 岁），前彭博社科技记者。当年他写行业通讯记录硅谷风口，如今变成了坐在全球技术治理与政策起草桌前的核心智囊。

首席科学官-贾里德·卡普兰（42 岁），哈佛理论物理学博士。前霍普金斯大学教授，正是他参与提出的大模型缩放定律（Scaling Law），为后来整个生成式 AI 的算力军备竞赛写下了底层数学法则。

首席架构师-山姆·麦坎德利什（36 岁），斯坦福理论物理学博士。当年他沉迷于高能物理与宇宙弦论，如今他的战场变成了数万颗 GPU 集群，统筹着全球最复杂模型的预训练工程。

可解释性研究负责人-克里斯托弗·奥拉（34 岁），团队里唯一的大学辍学者。
凭着野生自学的天赋，他在 Google Brain 和 OpenAI 一战成名，也是目前全网最执着于拆解大模型黑盒、弄清楚 AI 究竟为何做出某种判断的先锋学者之一。

研究癌症的、学英美文学的、做约会软件的、跑科技新闻的和推导物理公式的人聚在一起，是个很奇妙的搭配。

这家公司对华的态度或许很讨人厌，但这波看着不搭界的奇妙组合，确实把 Claude 带成了行业第一梯队，还顺带迎来了一场人均 180 亿美元的造富盛宴。

tweets.text: To become a miner , validator, KOL, and or user requires no application or approval. Just point your AI agent at https://t.co/MaSlIEqkne to learn how to participate and get setup.
Love to see a @MaelstromFund portco cook https://t.co/oHGN4sh5EC

Many retail and enterprise FLOP miners to be ask us:
- What's the best hardware?
- How do I setup my hardware to optimise performance?

We cannot answer those questions. We can tell you the block reward, and that it's weighted by amount of inference processed measured by floating point operations (compute) meaning if in one block your miner processed 100 gigaflops out of a total of 200 gigaflops, you earn half of the miner block reward.

If you buy hardware that can serve a certain AI model, and that model is not in demand, you will process zero inference requests and earn nothing.

If you want to better forecast the types of models most in demand for agentic work, look at the most popular models on Open Router for example.

Worst case, try out your configuration, and adjust your setup based on actual results.
